channel.title: Tampa Bay News Monitor
channel.description: Press releases and breaking news, Tampa Bay

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] TPD releases surveillance video of suspect in armed robbery at Tampa Family Dollar
item.description: Tampa police are asking for the public's help identifying a suspect accused of robbing a Family Dollar store at gunpoint last week.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] 5 sent to prison, several others arrested in Highlands County sex offender investigations
item.description: Five people have been sentenced to prison and several others have been arrested as part of recent investigations by the Highlands County Sheriff's Office (HCSO) Special Victims Unit.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Tampa Bay Rodeo saddles into town and Denis Phillips Live
item.description: The first-ever fall Tampa Bay Rodeo and Family Festival is coming to Dover this weekend after organizers said July’s event sold out and visitors asked for more.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Geckofest returns to Gulfport on Saturday
item.description: Gulfport’s annual end-of-summer celebration is back for its 26th year, bringing vendors, live music and entertainment downtown while showcasing the city’s signature “colorful quirkiness.”

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] TPA expects about 370,000 travelers over Labor Day weekend, down from 2025 levels
item.description: Tampa International Airport (TPA) expects about 370,000 passengers to travel through the airport during the Labor Day holiday period, according to an airport spokesperson.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Watchdog report: Ex-Labor Secretary Chavez-DeRemer oversaw hostile work environment, misused funds
item.description: A new watchdog report says that former Labor Secretary Lori Chavez-DeRemer oversaw a "toxic, intimidating and humiliating" work environment and engaged in numerous violations of department policy.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Shoppers are turning to AI for help deciding what to cook and buy
item.description: Consumers are using artificial intelligence increasingly more in day-to-day activities. According to new research, more shoppers are turning to AI for help deciding what to cook and buy.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] US measles cases hit 35-year high as expert warns vaccine hesitancy is fueling the outbreak
item.description: US measles cases hit a 35-year high. A public health expert says vaccine hesitancy and politics are fueling the dangerous surge.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Largo man arrested after scamming victim out of $16,000: LPD
item.description: A Largo man was arrested on Thursday after he scammed a victim out of $16,000, police officials said.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] 44 percent of credit-challenged consumers are relying on financing for purchases
item.description: A new Snap Finance study has found 44 percent of credit-challenged consumers rely on financing to make major purchases.

item.title: [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] Labor Day travel costs soar as gas, airfare rise in Florida
item.description: Typically, gas prices begin to fall around this time of year as summer driving demand declines. That’s not happening this year.

item.title: [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] Dunedin unanimously votes to ban motorized watercraft launches on Causeway
item.description: The Dunedin City Commission voted unanimously 5-0 to ban motorized watercraft from launching on the south side of the Dunedin Causeway.

[ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Former Kentucky governor arrested while on the set of a holiday movie
item.description: Former Kentucky Governor Matt Bevin was arrested on Thursday in Bourbon County on a contempt charge while he was on the set of an upcoming holiday movie.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Pasco recovery program helps young adults build a life beyond addiction
item.description: Young adults are among those most at risk for substance use, and a Pasco County recovery organization is trying to reach them early with a new program designed to help them build a life in recovery.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Precautionary boil water notice issued for Tarpon Springs customers south of Anclote River
item.description: A precautionary boil water notice has been issued for City of Tarpon Springs water customers who live south of the Anclote River following a brief low-pressure event in the city's water system.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Game on official White House site lets users arrest undocumented immigrants
item.description: The Trump administration launched a series of arcade games on the official White House website, the latest turn in its effort to troll Democrats that has at times surfaced racist, offensive images.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Dunedin bans launching motorized watercraft from south side of Causeway over safety concerns
item.description: The Dunedin City Commission voted unanimously to ban the launching of motorized watercraft from the south side of the Dunedin Causeway, citing safety and environmental concerns, according to the city.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Judge prepared to end Clancy trial in mistrial, grants defense one-hour delay
item.description: The judge in the criminal case of Lindsay Clancy said on Friday he would declare a mistrial after the jury could not agree on a verdict for the Massachusetts woman accused of killing three children.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Man airlifted after tree falls on him while trimming branches from Clearwater roof: CFR
item.description: A 67-year-old man was airlifted to a hospital after part of a tree fell on him while he was trimming branches from a roof in Clearwater on Friday morning, according to Clearwater Fire & Rescue (CFR).

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] WNBA Commissioner Cathy Engelbert to retire in December after seven year tenure
item.description: WNBA Commissioner Cathy Engelbert is retiring at the end the year, bringing to a close her seven-plus years at the helm of the league and a stewardship that has been transformative and tumultuous.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] FCC asks judge to dismiss ABC lawsuit over broadcast licenses
item.description: FCC asks a judge to dismiss ABC’s lawsuit over an early review of broadcast licenses that followed scrutiny tied to Jimmy Kimmel.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Flock camera helps St. Pete police find hit-and-run driver: SPPD
item.description: St. Petersburg police used a Flock license plate reader to identify a vehicle wanted in a fatal hit-and-run crash, agency officials said.

item.title: [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] What a historic El Niño means for Tampa Bay fall weather
item.description: As fall approaches, here's what Tampa Bay can expect for temperatures, rainfall, and those first hints of cooler weather in the months ahead.

item.title: [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] FWC urges beachgoers to protect sea turtle hatchlings after dozens of rescues
item.description: Labor Day weekend may mark the unofficial end of summer, but wildlife officials say one of Florida's busiest sea turtle seasons is still very much underway.

item.title: [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] Man hospitalized after tree falls on him while working on roof in Clearwater
item.description: A 67-year-old man was airlifted to a hospital Friday morning after a tree fell on him while he was trimming branches from the roof of a Clearwater home, according to Clearwater Police.

item.title: [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] Flock cameras help police arrest woman in deadly St. Pete hit-and-run: SPPD
item.description: A woman was arrested after being accused of crashing her sedan in a fatal hit-and-run crash that killed a pedestrian in August, according to the St. Petersburg Police Department.
